text:
Olivia Chen: quick sync — brightarc onboarding + sla reconciliation. customer asked for p95 latency target and what credit they'd get if we miss for quarterly renewal. want a short calc we can put in their health deck.
Ravi Patel: got it. can you confirm which environment they're on? hosted vs dedicated?
Olivia Chen: hosted (us-west). they were promised 'p95 <= 300ms' in onboarding docs but our default product SLO is p95 <= 350ms. there's a mismatch.
Marta Gomez: ugh. that's an onboarding doc drift. can we check the contract annex? might be verbal.
Diego Alvarez: pulling metrics now from reporting pipeline. rough numbers last 30d: p95 ~ 410ms, uptime 99.88%.
Ravi Patel: ok — if uptime < 99.9% we owe SLA credits per standard hosted policy. credit calc is tiered.
slo-bot: automated note: BrightArc tenant: last30d uptime=99.88%, p95=410ms, error-rate=0.02%. Report generated at 1955013000.
Olivia Chen: copy. need a short, customer-friendly blurb + concrete credit estimate and recommended remediation/next steps to reduce renewal risk.
Marta Gomez: recommended remediation: enable prefix caching for their high-volume routes, slide down batching window to 12ms for interactive routes, and schedule a dedicated eval for quantized LLM for cost/latency tradeoff.
Ravi Patel: for the credit estimate, use this quick calc: 
```
// hosted SLA credit calc (simplified)
if (uptime >= 99.9) credits = 0
else if (uptime >= 99.5) credits = 10% of monthly invoice
else credits = 25% of monthly invoice
```
Given their invoice ~ $48k/mo and uptime 99.88 => falls into 99.5-99.9 => credits ~= 10% => $4.8k (prorated).
Diego Alvarez: for latency guarantees we don't currently auto-credit for p95 misses (contractually). but for renewal negotiation we can propose a one-time 'service goodwill' credit equivalent to 5% of MRR and offer a remediation plan + 30d performance SLA with weekly checkpoints.
Olivia Chen: perfect. can someone draft the blurb for customer? short and calm. I'll run with it in the health deck then loop in AMs.
Marta Gomez: draft below — please tweak: 
"We tracked the last 30 days and observed a p95 latency of ~410ms against the onboarding target of 300ms. Uptime is 99.88% (hosted). Under our hosted SLA, this level of uptime maps to a credit of approximately 10% of the monthly invoice (~$4.8k) for the billing period in question. We recommend enabling prefix caching for hot routes and adjusting batching to improve interactive latency. Redwood will also run a focused performance pass (quantized model evaluation + tunings) and commit to weekly checkpoints for 30 days to validate improvements."
Ravi Patel: looks good. add: "If you'd prefer, we can apply the credit to next invoice or issue a one-time refund."
Olivia Chen: small additions: add timeline: "we can start remediation within 48hrs; expect measurable p95 improvement in 7-14 days"
Diego Alvarez: i'll kick off the infra ticket and set up dashboards for the customer-facing report. tagging @marta for the technical playbook.
Marta Gomez: will prepare the technical runbook and playbook doc, include config snippets for prefix cache + batching.
Olivia Chen: action items: 
- Diego: infra ticket + dashboard (owner)
- Marta: playbook + config snippets (owner)
- Ravi: credit calc + legal check on wording (owner)
- Olivia: customer-facing blurb + send health deck (owner)
I'll DM AM to schedule the renewal call after we have remediation plan. thanks team :thumbsup:
Ravi Patel: I'll also confirm if contract annex actually states 300ms; if so we escalate to ops/legal.
slo-bot: scheduled report delivery to customer at 1955020000.
Olivia Chen: thanks — wrapping. we'll reconvene in the thread once Diego posts the dashboard link.
